en.title: Magic reportedly pursued Curry before Warriors tenure
en.dek: Dwight Howard stated the Orlando Magic were interested in Stephen Curry before he joined the Golden State Warriors.
facts: Dwight Howard stated the Orlando Magic were interested in Stephen Curry according to Kicker.
Stephen Curry has played for the Golden State Warriors for over 17 years.
Energie Cottbus and Hertha BSC will meet on Sunday, the first time since 2013.
body: Dwight Howard stated the Orlando Magic were interested in Stephen Curry according to Kicker.
Stephen Curry has played for the Golden State Warriors for over 17 years.
Energie Cottbus and Hertha BSC will meet on Sunday in a Pflichtspiel, which is the first time since 2013.
The match between Energie Cottbus and Hertha BSC is a Berlin-Brandenburg-Derby.
en.context: Kicker reported that Dwight Howard stated the Orlando Magic were interested in Stephen Curry.

de.title: Magic verfolgte Curry angeblich vor Warriors-Zeit

facts: Dwight Howard behauptete, der Orlando Magic hätten an Stephen Curry interessiert gewesen sein, bevor er zu den Golden State Warriors wechselte
Stephen Curry hat seit mehr als 17 Jahren für die Golden State Warriors gespielt
Energie Cottbus und Hertha BSC treffen sich am Sonntag, das erste Mal seit 2013
body: Dwight Howard zufolge waren die Orlando Magic an Stephen Curry interessiert, berichtete Kicker.
Stephen Curry spielt seit mehr als 17 Jahren für die Golden State Warriors.
Energie Cottbus und Hertha BSC treffen am Sonntag in einem Pflichtspiel aufeinander, das erstmals seit 2013 stattfindet.
Die Partie zwischen Energie Cottbus und Hertha BSC ist ein Berlin-Brandenburg-Derby.
de.context: Kicker berichtete, dass Dwight Howard behauptet habe, der Orlando Magic hätten an Stephen Curry interessiert gewesen sein.

ko.title: 매직, 커리 영입 추진했던 것으로 알려져
ko.dek: 드와이트 하워드가 스티븐 커리가 골든스테이트 워리어스에 합류하기 전 올랜도 매직이 그에게 관심을 보였다고 밝혔다.
facts: 드와이트 하워드는 키커에 따르면 올랜도 매직이 스티븐 커리에게 관심을 보였다고 언급했다
스티븐 커리는 골든스테이트 워리어스에서 17년 이상 뛰었다
에너지 코트부스와 헤르타 BSC는 2013년 이후 처음으로 일요일에 맞붙는다
body: 드와이트 하워드가 키커에 따르면 올랜도 매직이 스테픈 커리를 원했다고 밝혔다.
스테픈 커리는 골든스테이트 워리어스에서 17년 이상 뛰었다.
에너지 코트부스와 헤르타 BSC는 일요일에 의무 경기에서 맞붙으며 2013년 이후 처음이다.
에너지 코트부스와 헤르타 BSC의 경기는 베를린-브란덴부르크 더비이다.
ko.context: 키커는 드와이트 하워드가 올랜도 매직이 스티븐 커리에게 관심을 보였다고 보도했다.

body: Dwight Howard ha dichiarato che gli Orlando Magic erano interessati a Stephen Curry, secondo Kicker.

ja.title: カーリーはウォリアーズ在籍前にマジックから注目されていた模様
ja.dek: ドワイト・ハワードは、ステフィン・カリーがゴールデンステート・ウォリアーズに加入する前にオーランド・マジックが彼に関心を持っていたと述べた
facts: ドワイト・ハワードはKickerによればオーランド・マジックがステフィン・カリーに関心を持っていたと述べた
ステフィン・カリーはゴールデンステート・ウォリアーズで17年以上プレーしている
エネーギー・コットブスとヘルタBSCは2013年以来初めて日曜日に対戦する
body: ドワイト・ハワードは、キッカー紙によると、オーランド・マジックがステフィン・カリーに関心を示していたと述べた。
ステフィン・カリーはゴールデンステート・ウォリアーズで17年以上にわたりプレーしている。
エネルギー・コットブスとヘルタBSCは日曜日に義務試合で対戦するが、これは2013年以来となる。
エネルギー・コットブス対ヘルタBSCの試合はベルリン＝ブランデンブルクダービーである。
ja.context: Kickerはドワイト・ハワードがオーランド・マジックがステフィン・カリーに関心を持っていたと報じた

problemsFixed: The headline uses an active verb ('reveals') which is less factual than a statement of what happened.
The dek is not a single-sentence summary and is too long.
The facts list includes an attribution ('The report comes from Kicker') which should be integrated into the body, not listed as a standalone fact.
The body repeats information unnecessarily and uses weak attribution ('the report states').

The body contains filler and evaluative framing ('The Kicker article notes that there were multiple opportunities in history for Curry's career to have taken a different path. The revelation comes as part of broader sports coverage from the outlet.').
The context section contains speculation and evaluative framing ('provide context on how star players' careers can shift', 'represents a long-awaited reunion').
The body contains four short declarative sentences in the first paragraph, violating rhythm rule 11.
The body ends with an evaluative summary, violating rule 12.
The opening of the second paragraph does not start with the actor, number, or date, violating rule 13.
